verdict.rationale: GlitchTip documents its own programmatic surfaces: it aims for Sentry API compatibility, a CLI covers releases, deploys and debug-file uploads, and a built-in MCP server lets you browse and resolve issues and search logs. Nothing documents that the API matches everything the UI can do, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every path. Missing for 10: a published API reference or OpenAPI spec, documented UI-to-API parity for orgs, teams, projects, alerts and uptime monitors, and independent hands-on confirmation of parity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: GlitchTip aims to be Sentry API compatible. Anything that works with Sentry should also work with GlitchTip.
